name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.strictAtG_iff
typeText:
∀ (k : Nat) (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (n : Nat),
  Iff (Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.strictAtG k g n) Bool.true)
    (∃ (hv : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.Valid g),
      And (LE.le.{0} 2 n)
        (LE.le.{0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.threshold k n) 1)
          (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.dispersion g hv n)))

source.code:
theorem strictAtG_iff (k : ℕ) (g : GInstance) (n : ℕ) :
    strictAtG k g n = true ↔ ∃ hv : g.Valid, 2 ≤ n ∧ threshold k n + 1 ≤ g.dispersion hv n := by
  unfold strictAtG
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hv, hn⟩, h⟩
    haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
    exact ⟨hv, hn, by rwa [g.dispersionExecG_eq n hv] at h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hv, hn, h⟩
    haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hv, hn⟩, by rwa [g.dispersionExecG_eq n hv]⟩
